name: anim_dobe_throw
subject: a huge muscular Doberman monster made of glossy pink paint goo with yellow marble streaks holding a small black witch cat in a full nelson
desc: The goo monster crouches a little, then heaves and flings the trapped cat straight up into the air with both arms; the cat flies up and out of the top of the picture, leaving sticky goo strands; the monster ends with both arms thrown up overhead, empty-handed, grinning upward.
